requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send method is returning a coroutine object instead of awaiting it, causing AttributeError when trying to call .bind() on the coroutine.
requirement.contract: The _send method should properly await the generator send operation and return the correct Option type. The method should handle both synchronous and asynchronous generator yields appropriately.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method has the same issue as AsyncOptionBuilder - it returns a coroutine instead of awaiting it.
requirement.contract: The _send method should properly await the generator send operation and return the correct Result type. The method should handle both synchronous and asynchronous generator yields appropriately.

requirement.description: The async wrapper in AsyncOptionBuilder doesn't properly await the coroutine returned by _send, causing bind() to be called on a coroutine object instead of a resolved value.
requirement.contract: The async_wrapper should await the result of _send before passing it to bind operations. The binder function should handle async results properly.

requirement.description: The async wrapper in AsyncResultBuilder doesn't properly await the coroutine returned by _send, causing bind() to be called on a coroutine object instead of a resolved value.
requirement.contract: The async_wrapper should await the result of _send before passing it to bind operations. The binder function should handle async results properly.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.bind method incorrectly implements bind semantics - it returns only the first element instead of applying the function to all elements.
requirement.contract: The bind method should properly apply the function to all elements in the iterable and return a new iterable with the transformed elements.
